units.source_text: 由于是星期六晚上，温泉旅馆十分拥挤。

en.t: Since it was Saturday night, the hot spring inn was very crowded.
My older sister and her husband could not get a room.

units.source_text: 虽然已将桌子、长方形火盆搬到走廊上，可是四叠半的地方，也只能铺上两个睡铺。

en.t: Although the table and the long rectangular brazier had already been moved out into the corridor, the four-and-a-half-mat room could still only fit two beds.
